item.title: D-I, II district wrestling: Nine area wrestlers punch state tickets
item.description: At district tournaments on March 7, nine area wrestlers in Divisions I and II punched their tickets to Columbus for the state tournament on March 13-15. The Perrysburg district produced four state qualifiers, Lorain’s DJ Otero at 106 and Caiden Rosario at 113 and Avon Lake’s Brayden Patterson at 150 and Ambrose Ieropoli at 157. […]
